name: Conflict resolution
description: A simulator for practicing the reaction to complex emotions of the interlocutor. Learn to choose an empathetic path instead of a conflictual one.

start.text: It's Friday evening, and I'm all over. Burned out Will you finish my part?

options.text: I see that I have no strength. But I also have plans. How to optimize?
What exactly is left? Look, no promises.
Are you putting off work again on Friday?
Come here... I'm sitting at home anyway.

emp_1.text: Two bugs and tests. I cannot physically look at the monitor.

options.text: I will close the bugs, you will finish the tests on Monday. Ok?
I will, but this is the last time.
I want to help, but I have to go. rest
your problems Do it yourself.

neu_1.text: A couple of functions and tests. It's one o'clock for you, it's midnight for me.

options.text: I'll show you a faster way, we'll close together in 30 minutes.
I will make functions. You will complete the tests yourself.
I don't have resources for overtime. Until Monday.
I am not a free outsourcer. bye

bad_1.text: Why are you aggressing? We are a team! The ice will blow everyone away.

options.text: Broke, sorry. I will do a part.
The team is when everyone works and does not leave for others.
I'm angry Let's talk later.
Got it Don't write anymore.

sad_1.text: Thank you! I knew you would help. Access reset.

options.text: Ok, but you have coffee on Monday.
Ugh, I see. (take in silence)
I changed my mind, I don't have the strength. sorry
Do it yourself. I don't want to be extreme.

emp_2.text: I agree. But the PM asked to look at the migration of the database. are you looking

options.text: Bazu - on Monday together. Now rest.
No, we agreed only on bugs.
First the bugs, now the base? You are insolent.
Oh... well, give me another base...

neu_2.text: Agreed. But if the tests fail, QA will tear us apart.

options.text: I'll check locally, don't worry.
I am responsible only for my code.
Do you also set conditions? Do it yourself.
It's my fault again...ok, I'll check.

bad_2.text: I'm burnt out and I ask for help, and in response - silence or complaints.

options.text: Both are in the platoon. Let's compromise.
No emotions. What tasks are critical?
Tragedy due to inability to plan.
I defend the evening, but I became an enemy...

emp_3.text: Okay. Just worried about the release. The customer will be furious.

options.text: It won't be. A fresh head is needed. take a rest
The client will wait until Monday.
It's time for me. Everything will be ok, I'm disconnecting.
They are not interested in tantrums about the client.

neu_3.text: You are too principled. Just get into position.

options.text: I still enter, but my boundaries are also important.
Principledness saves from burnout.
There is an agreement, I went to do it. bye
You don't care about my plans. All.

bad_3.text: forget it I will do it myself. I will tell the leader how you "help".

options.text: Your right. I did not violate the processes.
say He knows who makes the estimates.
These are threats. Let's talk when you cool down.
Feel sorry for anyone. bye

emp_4.text: Thank you. You know how to calm down. I push and go to sleep.

options.text: Have a good sleep, until Monday.
come on I'm waiting for a push.
Finally agreed...
It would have been like this, instead of whining.

neu_4.text: OK. I push what I have and go. We'll figure it out on Monday.

options.text: OK, rest. I will pick up
Agreed. go to sleep
No advice, I know the job.
Ok, how do you say...

bad_4.text: You are toxic. I'm sorry for reaching out.

options.text: Both are tired. Drop your burdens, I'll help.
No emotions, let's end it.
Why does rejection make me toxic?
Mutually. Look for others.

emp_5.text: Dropped Thank you! I have coffee on Monday.

options.text: I'm taking my word for it! Have a nice weekend!
Accepted Until Monday.
I closed the messenger. Bye!
No need for coffee. Just don't bother.

neu_5.text: Check it out. I am offline.

options.text: Have a nice rest!
Accepted Until Monday.
I turn off notifications. Good luck
Finally. disappear

bad_5.text: The laptop closed. Do whatever you want.

options.text: Ok. Let's talk on Monday.
The tablecloth is the road.
Everyone needs to cool down.
Went to hell.

good_end.text: The conflict is resolved. You defended the borders and saved the team.

neutral_end.text: The situation was resolved dryly. There is sediment, but the work will be done.

bad_end.text: An open quarrel. The relationship is ruined.

kind_exit.text: You ecologically left the conversation without aggression.

rude_exit.text: A rough break. The conflict intensified.
